data.investment_objective: The Investment objective of the scheme is to provide reasonable returns and liquidity by investing in a range of debt and moneymarket instruments while maintaining the balance of safety, liquidity and returns such that the Macaulay Duration of theportfolio is between 6 months to 12 months.There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved

Pleaserefer the Scheme Information Document for more details.
